title: Dangerous function mcrypt_encrypt (php) — review required
description: The php call mcrypt_encrypt evaluates code, invokes by name, or uses a removed database extension. Untrusted input becomes execution or failure. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer removes it via openssl with an AEAD mode.
remediation: Remove or use openssl with an AEAD mode.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any mcrypt_encrypt call matches.
